capability: Let people read without the keys
title: Readers pass a one-way gate.

hook.picture: Close on the whale leaning in to read the live line. Its fin brushes a lever on the line, and the line jerks into a new shape.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: I only wanted to look, and I broke production.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: new team member in their first week

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: many people peer at the same live line, each within reach of its levers. Three brush them, every 2 beats, then 1, then ½.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Looking and changing use the same door.

stakes.body: Curious people break live systems, so teams stop sharing, and the people who need to understand the system never see it.

solution_hint: Give readers a copy with no keys.

metaphor.body: The live line gets a read-only twin behind a one-way gate. Readers can see every page, but the gate has no keyhole: a key card bounces off and nothing changes from the reading side.

steps.picture: The live line is copied into one flat page behind a gate. The gate has no keyhole.
steps.words: Copy the pages. Leave the keys out.

steps.picture: Push-in (z 1.28): a key card slides toward the copy's gate and bounces off. The live line does not move.
steps.words: Keys bounce off. Nothing changes from here.
steps.sound: A soft glass tap, clear and dry

steps.picture: Pods line up and read the copy. Each answers ✓ and leaves.
steps.words: Anyone can read. No one can break.
steps.sound: Gentle reading clicks, one per pod

steps.picture: The glass pane brightens once over the copy.

real_case.claim: jev-tape-wiki is a static review site: 43 pages compiled into index.html. It is "Not a live TypeSafe qualifier. No API keys."

honest_limit.picture: Still. The live line bends into a new shape, but the copy behind the glass keeps yesterday's shape. A reader pod acts on the old shape: rust flag.
honest_limit.words: The live system moved. The copy didn't.

not_this.body: A safe copy can still be old.

ending_pattern.body: The fin touches glass: the same curious lean now meets glass instead of a lever, and the live line stays calm.
ending_pattern.callback: The fin that jerked the lever in bar 1 now touches only glass.

end_belief.body: Let people read without the keys.
